Unilever Future Leaders Programme (UFLP)

Unilever Indonesia Early Careers

Lead from Day One. Grow with Purpose. Shape the Future.

The Unilever Future Leaders Programme (UFLP) is our flagship 36-month management trainee programme, designed to build future talents to be manager-ready and develop the next generation of Unilever leaders. 

From the start, you will take on meaningful business responsibilities that allow you to contribute directly to real company priorities. You will strengthen your leadership capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, mentorship, and exposure to senior leaders. Through this journey, you will accelerate your growth while creating meaningful impact for millions of consumers across Indonesia. 

As part of Unilever, our talents are exposed not only to the local business landscape but also to global markets, diverse ways of working, and cross-cultural experiences. Through the UFLP journey, participants will have the opportunity to take on meaningful roles, collaborate with teams across different markets, and gain international exposure — including international rotation opportunities where selected talents are sent to other countries to broaden their perspective and accelerate their leadership growth.

What is Unilever Future Leaders Programme (UFLP)

The Unilever Future Leaders Programme (UFLP) is Unilever's flagship 36-month accelerated leadership programme, designed to build future manager-ready talents across our core business functions who can grow, lead, and create impact across Unilever.

From the start, you will take on meaningful business projects that allow you to contribute directly to real company priorities. You will strengthen your leadership capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, mentorship, and exposure to senior leaders. Through this journey, you will accelerate your growth while creating meaningful impact for millions of consumers across Indonesia.

As a UFLP, you will benefit from:

  • Real business ownership & priorities from day one

  • Structured learning and leadership development, collaborated with National University of Singapore (NUS)

  • Opportunities to have international rotation to other Unilever country

  • A clear pathway toward future managerial roles

UFLP Functions 

We offer opportunities across our five core business functions, enabling you to build expertise, develop leadership capabilities, and gain meaningful business experience from day one. 

Each function offers a unique learning journey, but all share the same goal: building future manager-ready talents equipped to lead with purpose and drive impact. 

  • Marketing

    Build brands, create consumer connections, and develop innovative growth opportunities

  • Finance

    Support business decision making through financial insights, planning and strategic analysis


  • Human Resources

    Shape the employee experience and build organizational capabilities through people-focused strategies

  • Customer Development

    Drive growth through customer partnerships, sales excellence and market development strategies

  • Supply Chain

    Help deliver products efficiency through planning manufacturing, procurement and logistic excellence

UFLP Application Process

  • Step 1: Online Application 

    Complete the online application form. It is a simple and easy application process with the option of filling out your details using your LinkedIn profile. You may apply to only one function in your application.  

  • Step 2: Online Assessment

    Complete two stages of profile assessment; a portrait personality test and an online assessment. These are designed to look at different elements of your cognitive, emotional, and social traits. You will receive personalised feedback after completing each stage.

  • Step 3: Digital Interview

    The digital interview will consist of few questions followed by a business case. You will be asked to solve real-world problems using Unilever scenarios. You’ll be able to record and complete your interview anytime and anywhere.

    *Please note, we do not use AI as a screening tool in our recruitment process therefore, your digital interview submission will be reviewed by a real person*

  • Step 4: One-day Assessment Center

    The One-Day Assessment Center is an immersive assessment where candidates tackle a real business case through group and individual assessments, providing an opportunity to demonstrate their analytical thinking, business acumen, collaboration, and leadership potential.

  • Step 5: Board Interview

    During the Board Interview, candidates will meet with senior leaders to discuss their experiences, motivations, and leadership journey, while exploring their alignment with Unilever's values and culture.

  • Step 6: Medical Check Up & Offering

    The Medical Check-Up is conducted to ensure candidates are fit to perform their role and to support a healthy transition into their career journey.

UFLP Recruitment Cycle

While recruitment timelines may vary each year, UFLP opportunities are typically announced in Q2 of the year, with final candidate announcements made in September and successful candidates joining Unilever in October.

Recruitment Scams & Fraud Warning

Beware of recruitment scams claiming to represent Unilever Indonesia. All recruitment communications, applications, and assessments are conducted only through official Unilever channels and Unilever emails domain. Unilever Indonesia never charges fees or requests payments at any stage of the hiring process.
